reviews.text:
Outstanding app to organize recipes!. I’d been using Recipe Gallery for more than 5 years (containing over 3,000 recipes!) when they decided to switch to a subscription-based model. After researching replacement options, I am so glad I discovered Recipe Keeper.

First, their support is outstanding. When I inquired about import options from Recipe Gallery, the Recipe Keeper team said they would have one available for Recipe Gallery in a few weeks. They actually created an import process in less than a week, and also assisted me with creating an easily importable file when the app kept crashing during the import (we had to zip the .rga export from Recipe Gallery so my device could handle the file size). I had to do a little cleanup with my categories, but otherwise, the import process was quick and almost seamless.

What I love best about Recipe Keeper is the ability to import recipes directly from a URL. With Recipe Gallery, I had to take a picture of both the recipe and photo, and load them manually. Recipe Keeper makes the process so much smoother.

Other things I like about Recipe Keeper - 
* You can adjust the portion sizes easily in Recipe Keeper. You can permanently save those adjustments, or do them each time, depending on how many people you are feeding.
* You can link recipes within Recipe Keeper, such as when you frequently make an entree with a specific side - BRILLIANT!
* You can plan meals for the week, including multiple recipes per day (e.g., breakfast, entrees, sides), so it’s easy to find them when preparing meals.
* You can sort recipes by rating, and star favorites for easy locating. 
* You can add as many categories as needed. 

I often add notes when I add or switch ingredients, and notes are easy to add and view in Recipe Keeper. I do wish formatting were available with notes, like bolding or underlining. Maybe that will come in a future release. 

I was able to sync my recipes across my iPhone and two iPads easily. I don’t use Recipe Keeper on my iMac, but note that this requires a separate subscription based on the differing operating systems (IOS vs macOS).

While I don’t use the shopping list or cookbook options yet, I expect I will try them in the future. 

I’m so glad I found Recipe Keeper!
